title: A Spire for the Ember Anew
author: Felix Oyelaran
blurb: Rosalind Quintana, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
